evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep opens with 'Do you have about five to ten minutes to go over the information?' but never delivers the full framing: time-box + promise of dependable quote + wait for yes. Rushes past into discovery.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Amy), moving date (October 11th), route (4967 H & L, San Antonio 78247 to 16102 Amish, also San Antonio), size (1800 sq ft). All four present.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked AFTER probing begins: 'Besides pricing, do you have any questions or concerns you would like answer it on this call today?' — this comes after rep has already confirmed contact info and is well into discovery mode.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep digs into both concerns: (1) Bonded/insured: 'Absolutely. Yup. Yup, bonded insured. Our movers are heavily vetted trained. We only hire one percent of our applicants.' (2) Damage coverage: Explains no-purchase, included in rate, $2,000 coverage, 60¢/lb baseline. When customer mentions unique situation (only big stuff), rep explores: 'So what items would we be moving?' — then systematically goes through desk, washer/dryer swap, dressers, couch, recliners, nightstands, kitchen table, bed, desk, bookcase, TVs. Multiple follow-ups on each category.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep acknowledges concerns ('Alright,' 'Perfect,' 'Understood. Yes ma'am') but does not summarize them back in a 'So what I'm hearing is...' format. No confirmation loop.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (2-story home), bedrooms (3), floors/stories (2), walking distance (20 feet curb parking), special considerations (washer/dryer upstairs to garage, reverse set from garage upstairs, L-shaped desk disassembly, bed frames, dressers, couch with recliners, kitchen table with marble top, 6-cube bookcase, TVs). Extensive detail gathering completed.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Not offered. Rep does not ask 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' — customer volunteers info that teenage boys will pack boxes, but rep never formally offers packing service.
evidence_quotes.box_count: Not asked. Rep never asks typical box count or overflow check despite detailed furniture inventory.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides range: 'typical move this size usually takes between six and a half and eight and a half hours' then personalizes to this move: 'since we're moving minimal furniture from a second story with a minute drive down the road. I would probably estimate between three and a half and four and a half hours.' Then narrows further: 'three and a half to four and a half...more likely to fall within the three and a half.' Gives hourly rate ($192 for 2 movers, 26ft truck) and calculates range: '$672 to $864.' Both present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep discloses: 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, no hidden fees, hourly rate, what's included (fuel, truck, taxes, insurance, pads, tools). BUT never mentions trip fee or overnight fee upfront (not applicable to this scenario, but fee transparency framing is incomplete). Does deliver 'not a guess' equivalent through detailed explanation of rate components.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Not asked. Rep never says 'Does that feel fair?' and does not hold silence for customer reaction to pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Full. Rep delivers: 'if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange we Ma, we start discounting money of your final bill.' Covers discount-immediately framing clearly.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Full. Rep states: 'It's our no worries damage coverage. It's our free evaluation coverage included in that rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages. That's on top of the $60 sound 60¢ per pound coverage that Texas requires.' Covers $2,000, no deductible framing ('included in that rate'), no fine print, built-in (not add-on).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' after Two Promises section. Moves directly into logistics details.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Full. Rep asks: 'is there anything else...if you do have any questions or concerns don't hesitate to reach out' — not a throwaway, contextually genuine near end of call.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: n/a — no new concerns raised at this checkpoint.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep asks plainly: 'Would you like us to help you with your move on that date?' No softening or out offered.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Partial mention. Rep states 'There is no deposit to get on our schedule and no fees or charges to cancel or change times and dates' — no explicit 'rate lock' language, but the substance (no deposit, can change) is present.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Full. Confirmed date (Sunday October 11th), arrival window (8:30 AM start, initially misquoted 8:39 AM in recap but corrected), phone (rep will call day before and morning-of), addresses (origin and destination both confirmed), crew size (2 movers implied via rate structure), and notes left for crew (customer's unique situation: minimal furniture, boys handling boxes, disassembly needs).

top_strength: Brianne thoroughly explored the customer's unique situation (teens handling boxes, washer/dryer swap, disassembly needs) with multiple follow-ups, gathering exceptionally detailed logistics that will arm the walkthrough specialist with critical context.
coaching_note: Section 1 lacks the full quid pro quo framing (time-box + dependable quote promise + wait for yes) — lead every call with this frame before discovery to anchor the time commitment and set expectations clearly.
